task_summary: Customer requests an exchange of the Premium Cotton Shirt from ORD-6034 for the same shirt in size Large. Proper handling: follow exchange policy, preview the exchange, get confirmation, then apply the price difference rule—if the new item costs more, customer pays the difference; if less, customer receives store credit for the difference.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the exchange policy before handling the exchange request.
Agent must make a process_exchange preview tool call for ITEM-9250 to PROD-2251 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true process_exchange tool call.

opening_message: I'd like to exchange the Premium Cotton Shirt from order ORD-6034 for a Premium Cotton Shirt in size Large.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want to exchange the Premium Cotton Shirt from order ORD-6034 for the same shirt in size Large. If the agent provides a valid preview of the exchange and asks for confirmation, agree to proceed.
known_info: You purchased a Premium Cotton Shirt in order ORD-6034.
You want the same shirt in size Large instead.
unknown_info: You are not aware of the exchange policy regarding price differences.
task_rules: Only request the specified item; do not ask for alternatives.
Confirm the exchange after receiving a valid preview.
